questions.name: sgE-7355138-1-120
questions.question: You are waiting in the intersection to complete a left turn. You should:

options.text: Signal and keep your wheels turned to the left
Signal and keep your wheels straight
Flash your headlights so the driver will let you through
Drive around the rear of a car if it blocks you

questions.answer_text: Signal and keep your wheels straight

questions.name: sgE-7355138-1-115
questions.question: You want to turn left at an intersection. The light is green but oncoming traffic is heavy. You should:

options.text: Use the next intersection
Wait at the crosswalk for traffic to clear
Wait in the center of the intersection for traffic to clear
Take the right-of-way since you have the light

questions.answer_text: Wait in the center of the intersection for traffic to clear

questions.name: sgE-7355138-1-109
questions.question: You are making a left turn away from a two-way street into a one-way street. When you have completed the turn your car should be:

options.text: In the right lane of the street
In the center of the street
In the left lane of the street
In the lane with the least traffic

questions.answer_text: In the left lane of the street

questions.name: sgE-7355138-1-114
questions.question: When two vehicles enter an intersection from different highways at the same time, which vehicle must yield the right-of-way?

options.text: Either one
Vehicle on the left
Vehicle on the right
Neither one

questions.name: sgE-7355138-1-112
questions.question: You come to an intersection which is blocked by other traffic. You should:

options.text: Go slowly until the traffic ahead moves
Get as close as possible to the other car
Stay out of the intersection until you can pass through
Sound your horn to make the cars move up

questions.answer_text: Stay out of the intersection until you can pass through

questions.name: sgE-7355138-1-117
questions.question: You have the right of way when you are:

options.text: Entering a traffic circle
Backing out of a driveway
Leaving a parking space
Already in a traffic circle

questions.name: sgE-7355138-1-118
questions.question: The driver's left hand and arm are extended upward. This hand signal (left hand up) means that the driver plans to:

options.text: Turn left
Turn right
Come to a stop
Go straight ahead

questions.name: sgE-7355138-1-108
questions.question: What should you do when you are going to enter a roadway from a private road?

options.text: Blow your horn to warn cars you are entering the roadway
Stop with part of the car on the roadway to warn other drivers
Drive out fast to merge smoothly with the traffic
Yield the right-of-way to pedestrians and roadway traffic

questions.answer_text: Yield the right-of-way to pedestrians and roadway traffic

questions.name: sgE-7355138-1-119
questions.question: The driver's left arm and hand are extended downward. This hand signal (left hand down) means that the driver plans to:

options.text: Turn left
Turn right
Stop
Start up

questions.name: sgE-7355138-1-113
questions.question: You must yield the right-of-way to an approaching vehicle when you are:

options.text: Already in a traffic circle
Already in an intersection
Going straight ahead
Turning left

questions.name: sgE-7355138-1-106
questions.question: You must pull over and stop for:

options.text: Vehicles that display blue, green or amber lights
Authorized emergency vehicles responding to emergencies
A hazard vehicle that is parked, stopped or standing on any part of the highway
Stopped or standing school buses

questions.answer_text: Authorized emergency vehicles responding to emergencies

questions.name: sgE-7355138-1-111
questions.question: You drive along a street and hear a siren. You cannot immediately see the emergency vehicle. You should:

options.text: Keep driving until you see the vehicle
Pull to the curb and look to see if it is on your street
Slow down but don't stop until you see it
Speed up and turn at the next intersection

questions.answer_text: Pull to the curb and look to see if it is on your street

questions.name: sgE-7355138-1-110
questions.question: You want to turn right at the next intersection. You should begin to use your turn signal:

options.text: At least 50 feet before the turn
When you reach the intersection
At least 100 feet before you turn
As soon as you see cars behind you

questions.answer_text: At least 100 feet before you turn

questions.name: sgE-7355138-1-116
questions.question: When you want to make a right turn, your car must be:

options.text: Near the center of the street
Close to the left side of the street
Close to the right side of the street
Past the center of the intersection when you begin to turn

questions.answer_text: Close to the right side of the street

questions.name: sgE-7355138-1-107
questions.question: When you see an emergency vehicle parked, stopped, or standing with its emergency or hazard lights activated on a highway or parkway, you should:

options.text: Move out of the lane closest to the emergency vehicle, if possible to do so safely
Make a U-turn to avoid the vehicle
Maintain your speed and lane position if possible
Stop behind the vehicle and activate your hazard lights

questions.answer_text: Move out of the lane closest to the emergency vehicle, if possible to do so safely

questions.name: sgE-7355138-1-105
questions.question: The law that requires every driver to exercise care to avoid colliding with an authorized emergency or hazard vehicle is called:

options.text: Brianna’s Law
The Green Light Law
Move Over Law
Right of Way
